props.name: children
props.description: The content to display in the DropZone.

props.name: isFilled
props.description: Whether the DropZone already contains a file. Shows the replace message while dragging.

props.name: replaceMessage
props.description: The message shown while dragging over a filled DropZone.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined styles, returned by the `style()` macro.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLDivElement | ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }

props.name: onDrop
props.description: Handler that is called when a valid drag is dropped on the drop target.

props.name: getDropOperation
props.description: A function returning the drop operation to be performed.

props.name: getDropOperationForPoint
props.type: (types: DragTypes, allowedOperations: DropOperation[], x: number, y: number) => DropOperation
props.description: A function returning the drop operation for a specific point.

props.name: onDropEnter
props.description: Handler that is called when a valid drag enters the drop target.

props.name: onDropMove
props.description: Handler that is called when a valid drag is moved within the drop target.

props.name: onDropActivate
props.description: Handler that is called after a valid drag is held over the drop target.

props.name: onDropExit
props.description: Handler that is called when a valid drag exits the drop target.
